sections.heading: Ambernath MIDC and Additional Ambernath: Chemicals, APIs and Peptides
paragraphs: Ambernath, in Thane district, has two MIDC areas: the older Ambernath MIDC and Additional Ambernath at Anand Nagar. A Maharashtra Pollution Control Board regional industry database for the Kalyan area lists pharmaceutical makers in Additional Ambernath including Polypeptide, Ferring, Pharma Base India, Polydrug and Watson Pharma, alongside chemical units.

The estate is still adding pharma capacity. Asston Pharmaceuticals began commercial production at its Unit II at Plot W 18-A, Additional Ambernath, Anand Nagar, on 21 January 2026, with lines built to handle a range of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products for domestic and export markets.

sections.heading: Peptide and API Plants: Where Electropolished 316L Is Specified
paragraphs: Peptide and API manufacture brings together aggressive solvents, purified water, WFI for final steps and rigorous cleaning validation between campaigns. In that setting, electropolished 316L tube is the default for WFI and purified-water distribution, for product transfer after purification, and for the CIP supply and return that must prove each product has been removed.

Synthesis and solvent recovery are different. Their tube choice is driven by corrosion resistance more than surface finish. 316L handles many process streams, but strong acids, chlorides or hot halogenated solvents may call for higher alloys. We will tell you when an electropolished finish adds nothing and an alloy upgrade is what the duty needs.

If your validation team asks how the finish was measured, we report Ra on the internal surface of each electropolished lot, so the number on the certificate refers to the bore your product touches rather than to the outside of the tube.

sections.heading: Contract Chemical Units and Equipment Fabricators
paragraphs: Ambernath also has contract chemical manufacturers and fabrication shops building reactors, receivers and skids for pharma customers across the Mumbai region. They need tube in mixed sizes, cut to drawing, with certificates that can be passed on to an end user's quality team without rework.
For these buyers the useful things are consistent wall thickness for orbital welding, clean square cut ends, and heat numbers marked on every length so traceability survives fabrication.

sections.heading: What to Include When You Order Tube for an Ambernath Plant
bullets: Service: WFI, purified water, clean steam, solvent, product transfer or CIP. For solvents, include the chemical names and maximum temperature.
Tube to ASTM A270 with ASME BPE SF4 finish for hygienic duty, or ASTM A312 / A269 pipe and tube for process lines; state OD × wall for each.
Whether your validation protocol requires a specific maximum Ra, for example 0.38 µm or 0.25 µm, and whether borescope records are expected.
Fittings to match: electropolished bends, tees, reducers and clamp ferrules, so the whole loop carries the same finish.
Exact plot in Ambernath MIDC or Additional Ambernath for delivery; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with the quotation.
Each lot ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number, PMI records and an Ra report for electropolished tube.

sections.heading: Delivery to Ambernath
paragraphs: Ambernath is close to our Taloja MIDC works in the same Mumbai metropolitan region, so material moves by road. JNPT Nhava Sheva is the nearest container port for export-bound equipment.
